title: UPC Locator
description: Points into a SPECIFIC representation. A locator is (representation_ref, typed position); a position never stands alone. The value shape is constrained per type by the oneOf below. Only char_range is gate-bearing (anchors a verified quotation, §03); char_range counts Unicode codepoints, 0-based, end-exclusive, into the representation's UTF-8-decoded bytes. line_range counts lines 1-based and inclusive. The optional conforms_to/unit/reference/quote_hint members are advisory presentation metadata: they are siblings of value, are excluded from the ext- identity recipe (§06), and never influence the gate.

conforms_to.description: Advisory. The external fragment standard this locator's position is expressed in, for projection: rfc5147 (text #line=/#char=), media-frags (W3C Media Fragments #xywh=/#t=), pdf-open-params (PDF #page=). Never affects verification or identity (§03).

unit.description: Advisory. The counting unit of value. Text ranges: codepoint (the UPC default and the only gate-bearing unit) or utf16. Regions: pixel or percent. Never affects verification or identity.

reference.description: Advisory. The resolution frame a bbox was captured against; required in practice for a pixel bbox to be meaningful, since #xywh=pixel: is resolution-dependent (§05).

quote_hint.description: Advisory re-find hint, mapping to a W3C Web Annotation TextQuoteSelector. Lets a consumer re-locate the span by content when offsets drift. NEVER a substitute for the hop-B gate: a quote_hint is not verified.
